sokkel-tui.note: Not in sokkel-tui's reports as of b99664f.

summary: What a tracked thing is, as a map draws it: its kind's shape filled in its affiliation's color and turned to its heading, so a list, a card and a task's line show a track as the map does.

anatomy.container: A square, 48 units on a side in its own space, drawn at its size; nothing else.
anatomy.shape: The kind's outline pointing north (vessel: a hull with a pointed bow; aircraft: an arrowhead with a notched tail; vehicle: a box with a point on its front; other: a triangle), filled; a sensor is a ring 5 wide of radius 14 around a dot of radius 4.5, and never turns.
anatomy.heading: With heading: the shape turned that many degrees clockwise from north about its center.

affiliation.does: Fills it in track-<affiliation>; the ink around it without one.

label.does: Names it as an image; true names it by its affiliation and kind (Hostile vessel). Without it, it is decoration.

rest.note: track-<affiliation>: friend, hostile, neutral, unknown or pending; the ink around it with no affiliation.

sokkel-ui: An SVG of viewBox 0 0 48 48 with the outlines of lib/tracks (TRACK_OUTLINES), the same points the maps package draws its symbols from.

drift.today: As of b99664f its reports name no such part.
